I feel like I should add more to this, and this comment might need to be split into its own new feature request thread.

Considering the different platforms VRChat is run on, not everyone plays VRChat using a VR headset. Additionally, not everyone plays games like minecraft. Perhaps people play a variety of games, such as non-vr first person shooter, or maybe a game like VR Beat Saber; etc. It would make sense that users have the ability to pick and choose which external games they want to integrate with, as a means to prevent crashing their system if a user attempts to enter a portol for a game which they do not have on their system. 

Could we perhaps create a base platform to allow developers to integrate VRChat into their games? Maybe have a sort of 'profile' for players that shows their rankings in other games (sort of like a steam profile...or, use their steam profile if you like)? I think this could lead to a lot of potential, but as I said in the start of my previous post, this isn't something I've seen anyone specifically mention in a feature request, but has been sort of hinted at here and there. I think it's a good time to start the conversation :)

Doing a little research and found this. Wonder if there's any way someone can modify this mod to be vrchat compatible as stated before. Works with oculus+touch and vive, but also supports forge for those modded servers.

http://www.vivecraft.org

This will simply not happen, because VRChat Inc. does not own Minecraft and thus can not legaly make a port for both games. Also because Mc uses java and VRChat uses Unity (both different programs) it would take years of effort to the point where someone says its simply not possible.

While I do like Minecraft, and would love to also use my VRchat avatar in many games, I do doubt there will be any official way to go into Minecraft from VRchat, mostly due to what @{5a37d208da34d93efc2dc967|full_name} said already.

I have done stuff in Minecraft, with VR, it's great!  I even customized controls to resemble VRchat's controls!  

I'll still upvote, because I would like this, but I doubt it'd ever happen, nor do I think there is a feasible way to even incorporate, even if through some sort of mod, or other unofficial means.

details:
I've seen it kind of hinted at here and there for Minecraft VR to be integrated into VRCHAT, but no one has made an actual request for it, so here it is. I've never really jumped into Minecraft VR but have heavily played Minecraft normally and have absolutely loved it. 

It'd be an absolute boost to the VRChat community to be able to have a Minecraft server setup and allow members to create portals to them to play in them from the VRChat app.

I think the best way to move forward with this isn't to introduce Minecraft INTO VRChat, rather, allow a port from one game to the other and back. Obviously this means you'll need a mod for both minecraft and for VRChat, and the end user will be required to have minecraft already installed on their computer for this to work.

Essentially, a user enters a portal for a VR Minecraft World and it swaps over to the Minecraft app, whichever is set to default (if using Vive, I think there's a Vive one that can be used, but I think the servers that would allow for mods to be created are windows based only, using forge and the like). Then, when they want to go back to VRChat (maybe the program can be held in cache?) they simply enter a portal within the minecraft game and it goes back to VRChat.

I think it should be possible to create a minecraft mod that would allow you to use your avatar skin as well...maybe. What do you guys think, is this doable? I really think it would boost the functionality of VRChat if we could do this.
title: Minecraft Integration
